name: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions
summary: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions bear the realm's insignia, but their owners vanished on patrol in eastern Elwynn Forest. Guard Thomas seeks the tokens to learn what became of his men.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Guard Thomas, station commander in eastern Elwynn, feared the worst when Rolf and Malakai vanished along the riverbanks. Their medallions confirm the guards died at the hands of encroaching murlocs. For the Stormwind garrison, these tokens mark the loss of soldiers who held the line against wilderness threats while the kingdom's military was stretched thin.

sections.title: Tokens of Service
sections.body: Human guards on city watch and rural patrols carry identification medallions that show their allegiance and authority under the crown. Returning Rolf and Malakai's tokens to Guard Thomas lets him account for his missing men, record their sacrifice in his field report, and warn of aggressive murloc tribes settling near the trade roads.

faq.q: What are Rolf and Malakai's Medallions?
faq.answer: They are the service identification tokens carried by Rolf and Malakai, Stormwind guards ambushed and killed by murlocs while posted in eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who do these medallions belong to?
faq.answer: They belonged to Guards Rolf and Malakai, stationed under Guard Thomas to watch the river and roads between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Who should I bring these medallions to?
aliases: where do i turn these in
faq.answer: Bring them to Guard Thomas, who keeps watch at the eastern bridge on the road between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Why are these medallions important to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas sent both guards on patrol and feared they had met a foul end. Their medallions confirm their deaths, letting him record their sacrifice and warn Stormwind of the rising murloc threat.

angles.text: Even in the heart of the Alliance, local guardsmen face deadly peril while guarding rural trade routes.
For humans of Elwynn, these tokens mark the loss of sons and defenders. Their deaths show the kingdom's vulnerability while its military is occupied elsewhere.
